preconditions.description: The number of rows n is between 1 and 2500 inclusive.
The number of columns m is between 1 and 2500 inclusive.
The number of actions q is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 3 for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions)
preconditions.description: Each action type t is either 1, 2, or 3.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= r1 <= r2 <= n for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions if t in (1, 2, 3))
preconditions.description: For actions 1, 2, and 3, the row coordinates r1 and r2 are valid and r1 <= r2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c1 <= c2 <= m for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions if t in (1, 2, 3))
preconditions.description: For actions 1, 2, and 3, the column coordinates c1 and c2 are valid and c1 <= c2.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= r1 <= r2 <= n - 1 and 2 <= c1 <= c2 <= m - 1 for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions if t == 1)
preconditions.description: For action 1, the row and column coordinates are strictly between 2 and n-1, and 2 and m-1 respectively.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= r1 <= r2 <= n - 1 and 2 <= c1 <= c2 <= m - 1 for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions if t == 2)
preconditions.description: For action 2, the row and column coordinates are strictly between 2 and n-1, and 2 and m-1 respectively.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in ['Yes', 'No'] for i in range(len([t for t, _, _, _, _ in actions if t == 3]))
postconditions.description: For each of Koyomi's attempts (actions with t = 3), the output is either 'Yes' or 'No'.
